name: Deleverage-rally fade (1h short the participation-less pop)
rationale: MECHANISM (the economic MIRROR of H1, and the reason H1 needs a direction gate): when price RISES while OI FALLS, the move is short-covering / long profit-taking with NO fresh leverage entering — a 'participation-less' rally that 2025-2026 desk commentary repeatedly flags as stalling fast. The counterparty to our short is a short-coverer who buys to close and then STOPS buying; once covering is done there is no marginal bid, so the pop mean-reverts down. Edge persists because rising price on falling OI is a recurring microstructure signature of an exhausted bid, not an arbable level. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (OI contracting) AND ret_Nd above a POSITIVE floor (price rising into the contraction — the divergence) AND rsi above an overbought floor (extended) AND adx below a ceiling (no genuine trend, so reversion not breakout). DISCONFIRMER: replace OI-down with OI-UP (rising OI + price-up = healthy leveraged continuation) — if the result does NOT flip to losing, OI divergence is irrelevant and this is just shorting overbought RSI; and it must NOT profit in the same windows as H1 (if the long and its mirror-short both make money on overlapping bars, the OI-direction read is noise). Must clear fees net.
catalyst: OI contracting while price pops into overbought with no trend — an exhausted bid to fade
